purpose: Primary-source unit observation for offline conversion tests; a field name alone is never a unit assertion.

observations.observation: The retained REST resize documentation identifies DISK_SIZE as gibibytes (GiB), while the request field is named sizeGb.
observations.offline_rule: A conversion to bytes for this explicitly evidenced case uses GiB (2^30 bytes); do not infer units from a provider field name in other cases.
